sourceFacts.appearance: Maintained red/white exterior; published authority text confirms restoration completion in summer 2026. Small details follow the genuine April 2026 Ristna close photograph and earlier records.
sourceFacts.basis: National aid 673 gives 27.2 m base-relative height and WGS84 location. Society archival 1925 elevation and sections identify eight concrete-jacketed ribs and three braces; cited industrial-heritage record gives a 5 m service drum. Genuine April 2026 Ristna photograph controls fittings, prior to repainting. July 2026 reopening article confirms works in text; its lead photograph depicts Mehikoorma and is excluded as a Ristna visual reference.

appearance.identity: Red concrete-jacketed eight-rib tower with three braces, expanded 16-port service drum, scalloped gallery, diamond glazing and white dome/vane.
appearance.epoch: Maintained red/white exterior, reconstructed from the operator photograph, genuine April 2026 pre-restoration close photograph, society aerial and archival section.
appearance.master: Preserve the original 68696-triangle master, true holes, radial plates, rail hoops and optical representation.
appearance.browser: Component-resampled street and closeup retain actual holes and stable regular dome facets. Far derivatives retain eight ribs, three braces, sixteen port positions, service drum and white dome; omit rivets, reduce gallery brackets and use opaque glazing.
appearance.exclusions: Surveyed minor fitting dimensions, post-restoration vent changes not shown in the accepted photo, interiors, detached station buildings, operational navigation light and surveyed site terrain.

geographic.notes: Mapped road is station context; no mapped tower footprint or surveyed doorway azimuth is available. Aerial coastal/station arrangement supports the southeast door quadrant, not a precise bearing. National authority anchor is retained instead of the offset OSM point. Y=0 is host terrain contact; no surveyed foundation elevation, detached station buildings or shoreline is included. Public API returned 429 on 2026-10-09; this review uses the dated 2026-09-28 map snapshot. +Y up; +Z southeast and +X northeast. Entrance quadrant is reconstructed from the inspected 2014 aerial and archival site layout; the eight ribs retain 45-degree rotational symmetry.
